market_portfolios.how_to_read: Values are FantasyCalc dynasty trade values (superflex, 12 teams, full PPR). move30 = 30-day market move of the players held now (trade-neutral). since_change = change since the snapshot dated `since` (includes trades). sidelined = value on IR/Out/PUP. Status flags: crash, correction, stable, bull.

trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

desk: Painty69 scored 73.58, the lowest total in the league, and stranded 103.12: Jahmyr Gibbs (44.2) and Joe Burrow (33.16) sat on his bench while Christian McCaffrey scored 46.3, the RB of the week, in the lineup. He started 42% of his best possible lineup, 176.7, and lost to Snipe58 by 79.44. The chat called it, three votes of four. He is 2-8 and 11th, and his MAXPF, the points a best possible lineup would have scored each week, added up (the lowest total picks first in the 2027 rookie draft), is 1674.2, the second-highest in the league.

Sarge71 lost to CMac91, 98.7 to 98.62, a margin of 0.08, and took the first pick anyway: his 1237.54 is now the lowest MAXPF, 51.8 below Snipe58. Snipe58 won by 79.44 and the win is what cost him, because his best lineup added 174.42 to Sarge71's 105.02. Zygon beat StealingGas 176.24 to 132.3, is 9-1 and holds the highest MAXPF, 1771.06, which is why he picks last. Johnny4Skins and fumbduckdumbfuck, both 6-4, meet in Week 11 in the game the desk is calling the playoff race.
